chunks.title: Why Asylkech: What families value most
chunks.text:
Ambitious learning — Small classes, attentive teachers and clear goals for every pupil, from first reading lessons to university preparation.

chunks.title: About Us
chunks.text: Asylkech is a girls’ school of the Indigo Academy network in Bishkek. We bring together a rigorous education and the warm atmosphere of a family.

chunks.title: Our story: A school made for girls
chunks.text:
A school made for girls
Asylkech Girls’ School was founded within Indigo Academy, a network of private schools in Bishkek known for its strong academic results and caring teachers.
Families asked for a school where their daughters could learn in a calm, focused environment that respects our culture and opens the door to the wider world. Asylkech is our answer: a school designed around the needs, interests and ambitions of girls.

chunks.title: Our mission
chunks.text: To educate well-mannered, knowledgeable and confident young women who serve their families, their country and the world.

chunks.title: Our vision
chunks.text: To be the first choice for families in Kyrgyzstan who want an excellent and values-based education for their daughters.

chunks.title: Our values: Five words we live by
chunks.text:
Respect — for elders, for friends and for every person’s dignity.
Knowledge — pursued with curiosity, discipline and honesty.
Responsibility — for our words, our work and our community.
Kindness — shown in small daily actions, not only in big words.
Leadership — the courage to speak, to start and to help others grow.

chunks.title: Director’s welcome: Dear parents and guests
chunks.text:
Dear parents and guests
Thank you for your interest in Asylkech Girls’ School. Choosing a school is one of the most important decisions a family makes, and we are honoured that you are considering us.
Our teachers know every girl by name. They notice when she is ready for a bigger challenge and when she needs a little more support. We measure our success not only in grades but in the confidence with which our pupils speak, the care they show for others and the dreams they dare to pursue.
I warmly invite you to visit us, to see our lessons and to talk with our team. Our doors are always open.
Director, Asylkech Girls' School

chunks.title: Girls-only education: Why a school for girls?
chunks.text:
More confidence — Girls take on every role, from team captain to science presenter, without hesitation.
Fewer stereotypes — Physics, coding and engineering are simply interesting subjects, open to everyone.
Calm focus — A quiet, respectful atmosphere helps pupils concentrate and enjoy learning.
Lifelong friendships — A close community of girls and women mentors that supports each other for years.

chunks.title: Our family: Part of Indigo Academy
chunks.text:
Part of Indigo Academy
Asylkech shares the experience, methods and teacher development programmes of the Indigo Academy network of schools in Bishkek.
Visit indigo.edu.kg

chunks.title: Academics
chunks.text: We follow the state curriculum of the Kyrgyz Republic and enrich it with an intensive language programme, STEM projects and preparation for olympiads and university.

chunks.title: How we teach: Our approach to learning
chunks.text:
Small classes — Teachers have time for each pupil, her questions and her pace.
Learning by doing — Experiments, projects and presentations make knowledge last.
Clear feedback — Regular assessment and open conversations with parents about progress.
Room to excel — Olympiad groups and extra classes for pupils ready for more.

chunks.title: School stages: From first letters to graduation
chunks.text:
Primary school — Grades 1–4 — A gentle start to school life with one class teacher who knows each child well. — Reading, writing and mathematics — English from Grade 1 — Art, music and handcraft — Learning through play and projects
Middle school — Grades 5–9 — Specialist subject teachers and the habits of independent study. — Science laboratory lessons — Informatics and robotics — Second and third language development — Research and project weeks
Senior school — Grades 10–11 — Focused preparation for exams, olympiads and university admission. — ORT preparation programme — Advanced mathematics and sciences — Career guidance and university advice — Leadership and volunteering

chunks.title: Languages: Three languages, one confident voice

Three languages, one confident voice
Our pupils learn Kyrgyz, Russian and English every week. English lessons are held in small groups by level, with speaking clubs, reading programmes and preparation for international certificates for older pupils.

chunks.title: Admissions
chunks.text: We are glad that you are considering Asylkech for your daughter. Our admissions team will guide you through every step.

chunks.title: Step by step: How to join us
chunks.text:
Get in touch — Call or message us on WhatsApp to ask about places in your daughter’s grade.
Visit the school — Tour the building, see lessons and meet the admissions team.
Meet and assess — A friendly conversation for future first graders. From Grade 2, a short assessment in mathematics and languages.
Submit documents — Bring the documents from the list below to the school office.
Welcome to Asylkech — Sign the agreement, receive your uniform information and get ready for the first day.

chunks.title: Documents: What to prepare
chunks.text:
Copy of the birth certificate
Copies of both parents’ passports
Medical record (form 026/u) and vaccination card
Personal file and report card from the previous school (for transfers)
3×4 cm photographs, 4 pieces
Application form completed at the school office

chunks.title: Tuition fees
chunks.text: Tuition is set for each academic year. Please contact the admissions office for current fees and payment options.

chunks.title: When can we apply?
chunks.text: The main intake for the new school year starts in spring. Transfers during the year are possible when places are available.

chunks.title: From what age do you accept pupils?
chunks.text: Girls usually start Grade 1 at the age of 6 or 7. We will invite you to a short meeting to see if your daughter is ready.

chunks.title: Is there an entrance test?
chunks.text: For Grade 1 we only have a friendly conversation. From Grade 2 we ask pupils to complete a short assessment in mathematics and languages.

chunks.title: Can we visit before applying?
chunks.text: Yes, and we recommend it. Call us to agree a convenient day and time for a personal tour.

chunks.title: Do girls wear a school uniform?
chunks.text: Yes. Our uniform is modest and elegant. Details are given to families after enrolment.

chunks.title: School Life
chunks.text: School is more than lessons. It is friendship, celebrations, new skills and the feeling of belonging to a family.

chunks.title: A typical day: A day at Asylkech
chunks.text:
08:00 — Morning welcome — Girls are met at the door by their teachers.
08:30 — Lessons begin — Core subjects while minds are fresh.
12:30 — Lunch and rest — Time to eat together and talk with friends.
14:00 — Clubs and study — Clubs, sports and supervised homework.
16:30 — Home time — Parents collect their daughters from school.

chunks.title: Traditions: Moments we celebrate together
chunks.text:
Knowledge Day — The first bell of the school year on 1 September.
Teachers’ Day — Concerts and gratitude for our teachers.
New Year concert — Performances, decorations and family guests.
International Women’s Day — A special day in a school full of girls, on 8 March.
Nooruz — Sumolok, national costumes and spring celebrations on 21 March.
Last Bell & graduation — Farewell to our graduates at the end of May.

chunks.title: Wellbeing: Care for every girl
chunks.text:
Class teacher — A trusted adult who follows each girl’s progress and wellbeing.
School psychologist — Support with emotions, friendships and exam stress.
Medical office — A nurse on site during the school day.
Partnership with parents — Regular meetings and open communication with families.

chunks.text: Our teachers are the heart of the school. They are experienced professionals who care about each girl’s success and happiness.
